gloss: no matter what; whatever the circumstances

definitions.gloss: no matter what; whatever happens; at all costs
definitions.explanation: States that the speaker's intention or the outcome will not change however things turn out. Used with strong determination or firm refusal, and often paired with a negative or a volitional form.

examples.japanese: どうあっても⟦{行|い}く→行く：00119_iku⟧。
どうあっても⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧⟦{条件|じょうけん}→条件：03285_jouken⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧のめない。
examples.english: I cannot accept those terms whatever the circumstances.

examples.japanese: どうあっても⟦{約束|やくそく}→約束：01517_yakusoku⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{守|まも}る→守る：01986_mamoru⟧⟦つもり→つもり：01152_tsumori⟧だ⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧、⟦{何|なに}→何：00498_nani⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦あって→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{明日|あした}→明日：00501_ashita⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{仕上|しあ}げる→仕上げる：04664_shiageru⟧。
examples.english: I intend to keep my promise no matter what, so I'll finish it by tomorrow whatever happens.

notes:
USAGE:
Literally "however things may be." It is emphatic and a little formal or literary, so it stands out in casual conversation; ⟦{絶対|ぜったい}→絶対：00435_zettai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ is the everyday equivalent.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- どうあっても〜⟦つもり→つもり：01152_tsumori⟧だ: to intend to do something no matter what
- どうあっても〜⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧: will not do something under any circumstances
- どうあっても⟦{譲|ゆず}れない→譲る：02323_yuzuru⟧: cannot yield on this whatever happens

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{何|なに}→何：00498_nani⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦あって→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧: no matter what happens — focuses on events, not on how things stand
- ⟦どうしても→どうしても：03476_doushitemo⟧: no matter how hard one tries; by all means — much more common, and also used of impossibility
- ⟦いずれにしても→いずれにしても：30653_izurenishitemo⟧: in any case — resigned acceptance rather than determination
